title: Maximum drop radius
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final expression for the maximum radius before separation: $r_{\text{max}} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{3 \sigma d}{4 \rho g}}$.

title: Charge on a drop
description: Essential: Correctly states the charge on a spherical conductor at potential $\varphi$: $Q = 4 \pi \epsilon_0 \varphi r$.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies the condition for droplet separation by equating gravitational force ($\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 \rho g$) to the surface tension force ($\pi d \sigma$).

title: Pressure balance for instability
description: Important: Identifies the instability condition by balancing the Laplace pressure ($2\sigma/r$) against the inward electrostatic pressure ($\frac{1}{2}\epsilon_0 (\varphi/r)^2$) to find $\varphi_{\text{max}}$.

title: Differential equation setup
description: Important: Sets up the correct differential equation for the capacitor charge $q(t)$ by relating the charging rate to the droplet charge $Q_0$ and the dripping frequency.

title: Final charge expression
description: Essential: Correctly expresses the absolute charge on a separating drop as $|Q_0| = 2\pi\epsilon_0 \frac{|q|}{C} r_{\text{max}}$.

title: Time dependence solution
description: Essential: Presents the correct exponential solution for the charge: $q(t) = q_0 e^{\gamma t}$, with $\gamma$ defined.

title: Maximum potential derivation
description: Optional: Correctly derives the maximum potential $U_{\text{max}}$ by considering the electrostatic force/energy balance between a falling charged drop and the collecting bowl.

title: Sign or absolute value error
description: Pitfall: Fails to use absolute value for $Q_0$ or $q$ in the expression for the charge on a separating drop, or mishandles signs in the exponential growth.

title: Pressure direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction (inward/outward) of the electrostatic or Laplace pressure in the instability condition for Part (3).
